text: This is Raysto: one system for the counter, the kitchen, and the table.
A snack bar at lunch. Staff tap the order on a tablet, and show a PayPal QR code.
The customer pays on their own phone, with PayPal.
Payment captured. Ticket three goes straight to the kitchen board, live.
At the table, guests share one room. Gemini builds the order from the real menu, and Raysto splits the bill to the cent. Everyone approves their own share in PayPal.
On the web, owners see every channel, every PayPal capture, refunds, and cash, kept apart.
Ask Raysto what needs attention. It checks the ledger, then asks PayPal itself, through M C P.
AI helps. People approve. PayPal moves the money. Raysto.
